slot_classification.signal: Canva's isMediaReplaceable marks every frame whose image can be swapped.
slot_classification.limitation: It does not distinguish a customer photo slot from design furniture that happens to be an image (torn paper, tape, textures) or from example imagery pre-filled into a real slot. Page 2 proved this: 3 replaceable frames, 1 real slot.
slot_classification.consequence: The 151 figure is an upper bound on customer photo slots, not the true count.
slot_classification.recommended_fix: Tag the real slots in Canva with autofill field labels (update_autofill_field). That makes the slot map authored rather than inferred, and feeds the Canva-as-renderer pipeline directly.
slot_classification.method: Elk twijfelgeval is getoetst door de lege template naast het gevulde magazine te leggen: verandert het kader, dan is het klantcontent.

canva_tagging.mechanism: edit-design update_autofill_field writes dataFieldLabel onto the frame's fill. Invisible — the page renders identically.
canva_tagging.tagged_pages: all 29 pages that hold customer photo slots
canva_tagging.note: Labels are bookkeeping only. Production rendering is the HTML/CSS rebuild; Canva's autofill API is Enterprise-tier and is not in the pipeline.
canva_tagging.verified: read back outside the transaction on pages 4, 32 and 36; every label persisted
